special.text: Prepaid POS limit is $25,000/day AND $25,000/MONTH (Ruby-Obsidian); top-ups $10k/day, $25k/mo. $50k/mo cannot go through this card.
$500,000 of CRO (~8.98M CRO at $0.0557 on 2026-09-15) locked 12 months, no early exit; if CRO value sinks below $500k the tier drops.
California: CRO STAKING is barred (no ~6% APY); CA residents use CRO LOCKUP stored with Crypto.com. Card itself is open to CA.
Prepaid Obsidian pays 4.5% in CRO up to $5,000 reward/mo, then 1%. The $25k spend ceiling binds long before that cap.
Credit twin (Visa Signature, Comenity): 6% CRO uncapped, no $25k wall, credit line unknown; bill = bank ACH only, no debit card.
Paid in CRO at swipe-time price; MCC exclusion list omits 5300 but Crypto.com may add categories at will; clawback for 'gaming'.
Top-up: fiat wallet/ACH free; debit card 1% ($1k/day, $5k/mo); credit 2.99%; PayPal 2.1%. Idle 12 mo = $5.95/mo. FX 0% on Obsidian.

tiers.name: Featured rotating altcoin, app-set up to 4% (unpublished)

special.text: Daily spend cap $5,000 (since 2025-10-14, was $2,500): one $3,800 bar per day. Risk-based tiers to $100k/day promised mid-2026, unverified.
Reward rate is unpublished: set per coin in the app and rotates; 4% only on a featured altcoin, ~1% on BTC/USDC. Treat 3% as an estimate.
Spend from Coinbase USD/USDC balance = 0 spread, free ACH in. Paying from BTC/ETH sells at ~0.5-2% spread and is a taxable sale.
Pathward Visa debit, PIN or signature at the register; MCC 5300 not on the exclusion list (ATM, reloads, crypto buys, P2P, loan pay).
Coinbase One Card (credit) is on the AMEX network: Costco won't take it. Its 4% needs $200k on Coinbase, caps at $10k/mo, then 2%.
Cardholder agreement bars business use; Coinbase terms let it cut rewards for 'manufactured spend' at its discretion. Not offered in Hawaii.
Card balance cap $25,000 and loads $5,000/24h, but USD-balance spend needs no load, so the $5k/day POS cap is the real ceiling.
Not open to US residents (issuer list = EU/EEA, UK, CH, LatAm); US only 'coming soon'. Direct signups closed; via Zeal (EU)/Picnic (BR).
Cashback-eligible spend is capped WEEKLY: $250/$375/$500/$1,250 by GNO held (0.1/1/10/100). Best case ~$5.4k/mo earns anything.
Interim programme runs 2025-11-09 to 2026-09-30; 'rapid repeat transactions to same merchant' are excluded, so multi-swipe gold runs void.
4% needs 100 GNO held (~$11,700 at ~$117, 2026-09-12): not locked but fully price-exposed; +1% only with the legacy OG NFT.
Safe is EUR/GBP-denominated; every USD swipe pays Visa FX (~1.5% est.), which alone eats most of the 4%.
